At 50.7x trailing P/E, the stock carries a rich valuation that leaves little room for earnings disappointment. AI-driven drug discovery is compressing R&D timelines for Indian pharma, while strong US generics demand and a healthy domestic prescription market provide dual revenue engines. India's CDMO opportunity is also expanding as global innovators diversify manufacturing away from China. Analyst consensus is BUY — the current price is seen as offering an attractive risk-reward for medium-to-long-term investors willing to look through near-term volatility.
